limitations: Eight curated lineages in six projects;65 unique historical files and252 observations are dependent coverage, not independent defects.
Two pinned deployments differ in provider, precision and model. Two conversations per task/deployment are descriptive repeats, not a size-causal or significance study.
Four lineages were used during development; four are newly introduced here, spanning only two entirely new projects. Public historical fixes can occur in pretraining.
Custom localized scaffold supplies affected files and historical producer source; no arbitrary shell, dependency installation, web lookup or unrestricted coding-agent environment is supplied.
Up to24 exploration rounds; at most6 executed actions per response; reads160lines and literal search16matches. Each exploration output is capped at4096 tokens; final report2048 tokens.

Shown tool output truncates above24000 UTF8 bytes. Exploration stops above120000 request bytes; deterministic marked compaction targets135000 bytes; wire request ceiling160000. Archived raw output is not necessarily present verbatim in model context.
Finalization is separately reserved and uses temperature0, no tools/schema; exploration temperature0.2. Honest inability can satisfy the report protocol without semantic repair success.
Transient identical requests have up to3 attempts and no provider-routing fallback. All returned costs must be summed, including successful transport retries; missing cost cannot be treated as free.
Checks run in one-CPU1GB no-network LinuxARM64 containers with readonly code/fixtures and temporary working files.90s normally,240s for dtype checks. Infrastructure errors are not semantic failures.
12 dtype reader processes reuse6 historical artifacts;18 nonpublic observation rows revisit public bytes. Hidden row identifiers do not guarantee unseen artifact bytes.

Fixed-reader observations and input-derived invariants are finite contracts, not general proofs. Test-passing patches require independent source review for fixture-specific logic and harness manipulation.
Optional generated tests are separate: submission, collection, body execution and passing are distinct. Their absence/failure is not a post-hoc primary semantic failure.
The prior two-lineage12-attempt genuine upstream comparison found0 additional rejections among2 upstream-accepted patches; no stronger-evaluator claim follows.

The10-file main runner snapshot is the declared core snapshot, not a closed capture of every transitive local import, old import-time configuration or shared remote runtime. Supplemental identities must be labeled by when observed.
